title: 10 Day Morocco Itinerary – The Ultimate Route
description: A perfect 10-day Morocco itinerary covering Marrakech, Fes, Chefchaouen, the Sahara and more. Expert local tips for every stop.
content:
## Day 1-3: Marrakech

Explore the medina, Majorelle Garden, and Bahia Palace. Take a day trip to the Agafay desert for a hot-air balloon ride.

## Day 4-5: Fes

Drive through the Middle Atlas to Fes. Get lost in the world's largest car-free medina, visit the tanneries, and discover hidden madrasas.

## Day 6-7: Chefchaouen

Head north to the Blue City. Photograph the iconic blue alleys, hike to the Spanish Mosque, and visit the Ras El Maa waterfall.

## Day 8-9: Merzouga (Sahara)

Cross the Atlas to the Erg Chebbi dunes. Camel trek at sunset, sleep in a luxury desert camp, and wake up for a spectacular sunrise.

## Day 10: Casablanca or Marrakech

Return via Ouarzazate and the High Atlas, or fly out from Casablanca.
